title: ipomoea batatas var. littoralis
intro: Ipomoea batatas var. littoralis, commonly known as sea island sweet potato, is a variety of the Ipomoea batatas plant that is native to coastal regions. This plant is rich in nutritional value and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of sea island sweet potato include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and protecting against oxidative stress, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins. The bioactive constituents of sea island sweet potato have been shown to have anti-cancer, anti-bacterial, and anti-viral activities, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions.
